notes.title: Patchnotes v0.4.8.25.1
notes.content:
Hello, Unibot testers!

Hope you're all having a great time with your AI companions. We’re excited to roll out a new patch, version 0.4.8.25.1, bringing some major quality-of-life improvements and new creative tools to your Unibot experience. Let's dive into what's new!
[hr][/hr]

What’s New in This Patch?


External Editor & 2D Avatar Creator: Ever wanted more control over your bot's personality and appearance? Now you can! We’ve added an external editor for .json file editing and creation, giving you the power to fine-tune your bot’s settings. Plus, we’ve included a brand new 2D Avatar Creator, so you can design and customize your bot’s visual identity with ease.

Audio-Streaming Mode: We heard your requests for faster responses! We've implemented a new "Audio-Streaming-Mode" that reduces the latency from audio generation to playback. This means your bot's voice will start playing faster, making conversations feel much more natural and fluid.

Emotion Detection Toggle: For those of you looking to optimize your resource usage, we've added a new option to disable the bot's emotion-detection. This will help save on AI requests, giving you more control over your usage.
[hr][/hr]

Changes & Fixes


Gemini-API Error Handling: We’ve beefed up the error handling for the Gemini-API. If something goes wrong, you'll now get a much clearer and more descriptive error message, helping you troubleshoot issues more effectively. No more cryptic codes!

Blockfilter Adjustments: It seems our blockfilter was a little too enthusiastic and was blocking messages it shouldn't have. We've gone in and made some adjustments, so your bot should now respond to a wider range of messages without being overly restrictive.
[hr][/hr]
As always, thank you for your continued support and for helping us make Unibot better with every update.



Happy botting!



Sascha

notes.title: Patchnotes V0.4.8.22.1
notes.content:
Hello there, fellow bot wranglers!

We’re back with another update for Unibot, version 0.4.8.22.1! This patch is packed with some great new features and fixes, many of which came from the fantastic feedback we received. A huge shout-out to 

[dynamiclink href="https://twitch.tv/khasul"][/dynamiclink] for all the help! Their insights were invaluable in shaping some of these changes.
[hr][/hr]

What's New?


Piper TTS Engine: We've added the Piper TTS engine to Unibot! This new engine is a performance beast, providing much faster and more efficient text-to-speech. While it currently supports fewer languages out of the box, we think you'll appreciate the speed boost. The best part? There's no extra work for you. Piper installs itself automatically the next time you launch Unibot.

Subscriber-only Mode: Thanks to feedback from the community, we've implemented a new Subscriber-only mode. Now you can set your bot to respond only to your Twitch subscribers, giving them an exclusive experience.

Avatar Invisibility Cloak: Is your avatar hanging out on screen when it has nothing to say? Not anymore! We've added an option to hide the avatar when it isn't speaking, keeping your stream clean and clutter-free.

Encyclopedia Sharing: Want to share your knowledge base with a friend or back it up just in case? You can now import and export your encyclopedias! We’re hoping this feature will lead to some fun and interesting collaborations.
[hr][/hr]

Bug Squashing Time!


RVC Voices: Remember when your RVC voices went on a little vacation? They're back! We've patched things up, and RVC voices are now being fetched correctly from the server.

CUDA Switching: Switching between CUDA devices should no longer be a headache. We’ve improved the backend to ensure this process works exactly as intended.

2D Avatar Positioning: We know you've been wanting more control over your 2D avatars. Their positioning has been improved, so you can place them just right on your stream.
[hr][/hr]
Thank you again for all your continued support and feedback. We’re always working to make Unibot the best it can be, and your suggestions are what make that possible. If you encounter any bugs or have ideas for future features, feel free to reach out to us!

Happy botting!

notes.title: Patchnotes v0.3.6.17.1
notes.content:
Patchnotes v0.3.6.17.1


- NEW: Added Settings to the API Settings to change the Creativity, Spontaneity and Focus of the Gemini Model.

- NEW: Added two options to the TTS-Settings. One will enable stronger PCs to use Deepspeed for faster generation times, the other will enable Low VRAM Mode, to save GPU ressources on older/weaker GPUs.

- FIX: Fixed an issue, where the set voices where not saved / set correctly when selecting a model in the character visuals menu.
